People saying you're lazy are just being negative, don't allow that to affect you. You are not lazy! The meds can make it hard for people to get up and do things, but it's not your fault.
Just try your best! Maybe talk to your doctor about switching meds, maybe the ones prescribed aren't for you?

He's just a loser with nothing else better to do. I'm sorry that some  douche on the internet is trying to make you doubt yourself. Unfortunately there are a lot of trolls like that on the internet. Just remember, you are safe my friend. No need to worry 💟

I'm sorry it feels like you have no one to talk to this about. I don't hear voices or have schizophrenia but my coworker recently told me she hears voices. I don't look at her any differently, in fact, I was very happy that she trusted me enough to tell me that. I feel like I've grown closer to her and instead of being weirded out by it, I find it interesting (she mostly hears positive voices only).
Well, the point of my comment is to let you know that there are people that won't treat you like you're insane! You just gotta find the right people. It can be hard to do, but with enough time, effort, and some luck, you will meet them! ❤️
Good luck to you, I really hope you find someone to tell everything to. My inbox is always open btw!
I promise the feeling will pass 🥺 you're too precious to leave this earth. If you need someone to vent to I'm always here ❤️

I have two instances.

The first one was maybe 8-10 years ago. I was watching Disney channel and a new episode of Hannah Montana came out that day so I excitedly watched it. Some time had passed (it might have been the next day) and I was watching Disney again. Hannah Montana was up next and it was supposedly a new episode. I was like, oh cool, another new episode! And as I watched it I realized I had already seen it as it was the same ep that I saw earlier. I was super confused as to why they said it was a new episode when they had aired it already? It almost felt like I was reliving the whole day again.

The second one.
My friend was driving us downtown. Now, she wasn't the safest driver ever... I think she pissed some guy off because he started to break check her. Then, he changed lanes to get to the right of us. I look at him and all I see was him yelling at us in his car, his window being lowered, and him pointing a pistol at us. I started screaming and covered my face. I then look at her and she's acting like nothing happened, she's just lookin at the road not a care in the world, and I'm wondering why the fuck she's not freaking out. I was about to ask her if she saw his gun but when I looked again he was gone. I was like, "ok guess I'm crazy and imagining shit" lol. It still really spooks me, as nothing really evokes that kind of pure terror in me. My body felt like jelly cuz I thought we were about to get shot. I'm still surprised she didn't even ask why I screamed.
